interface.title: Protein Cleaver
interface.stage_of_work: Experiment planning and interpretation: in-silico digestion before or after an LC-MS/MS bottom-up proteomics run
interface.what_it_is_for: Digest a ProForma protein sequence in silico with chosen proteases and settings, predict charge, m/z, retention time, ion mobility and proteotypic score for each peptide, and see sequence coverage, cleavage sites and motif sites on the protein.

data.note: On load the sequence box holds the default SARS-CoV-2 spike protein with trypsin and Cys carbamidomethyl (+57.02146) already set, so results appear at once. Later I pasted human ubiquitin with a ProForma phospho mass shift (TLS[+79.96633]DY…) to test my own input. I did not use the UniProt fetch because there is no network.

features.name: Multi-protease plus custom-regex digestion
features.general: Pick one or more named cutting rules from a list, optionally add your own rule as a pattern, and see the resulting piece list and counts update
features.specific: Proteases multiselect (trypsin, chymotrypsin, asp_n, glu_c, lys_c…) plus a (Additional) Custom protease regex field. Results give Total/Semi/Enzymatic/Unique peptide counts
steps: open Proteases dropdown and choose one or more enzymes
remove an enzyme with its × chip
type a lookahead/lookbehind regex in Custom protease and press Enter
read updated peptide counts and table
serves_tasks: Pick one or more standard cutting agents
Define a custom cutting rule as a pattern

features.name: Digestion parameter filters
features.general: Restrict generated pieces by allowed missed cuts, size range and mass range, with an option for partly specific ends and a choice of mass calculation
features.specific: Max missed cleavages, Min/Max length, Min/Max neutral mass steppers, Mass type (monoisotopic/average) and Semi enzymatic? checkbox
steps: step Max missed cleavages with +/−
type length limits
type neutral-mass limits
toggle Semi enzymatic?
switch Mass type
serves_tasks: Match the prediction settings to the measurement's search settings
Allow pieces with one non-specific end
Switch between exact and average mass calculation

features.name: Predicted-property columns with charge/m/z range and detectability filters
features.general: Add model predictions (charge, m/z, retention, mobility, detectability score) to each item, keep only items within a chosen charge and m/z range, and hide items below a chosen score threshold
features.specific: Peptide Properties expander: Infer Charge (min/max charge, m/z range, which also drop out-of-range peptides), Infer RT (gradient minutes, Filter invalid RT), Infer Ion Mobility (IM column shows once Infer Charge is on), Infer Proteotypic-ness with Filter Non Proteotypic Peptides and Proteotypic Score Threshold
steps: expand Peptide Properties
tick Infer Charge to add Charge/Mz/IM columns and keep peptides within the charge and m/z range
tick Filter Non Proteotypic Peptides
raise Proteotypic Score Threshold
read reduced peptide list and coverage
serves_tasks: Add predicted measurement properties to each piece and keep only pieces within the measurable charge and m/z range
Drop pieces unlikely to be detected, at an adjustable strictness

features.name: Static modification editor
features.general: Set fixed mass shifts on chosen residues and on piece ends in an editable table, and see them written into each piece's notation and mass
features.specific: Static Modifications expander: Internal Modifications data editor (Amino Acids, Mass (Da)) plus N-/C-Terminal target amino acid multiselect and mass
steps: expand Static Modifications
double-click empty row and choose an amino acid
edit Mass (Da)
choose N-terminal target residues and type a mass
read modified sequences like M[+15.9949]… and [+42.01057]-T…
serves_tasks: Apply fixed chemical modifications to chosen residues and piece ends

features.name: Residue-grid coverage heat map with cut-site map
features.general: Show the whole sequence as a grid of letters coloured by how many pieces cover each position, alongside a summary of covered fraction and marked cut positions
features.specific: Cleavage & Coverage tab: Cleavage Sites count, Protein Coverage %, Site Indexes chips, Sites grid with % at cleavage points, Sequence Coverage grid with a 0–N colour bar
steps: change digestion or filter settings
open Cleavage & Coverage
read coverage % and site indexes
scan the colour-coded residue grid for uncovered regions
serves_tasks: Check covered fraction, cut sites and coverage along the sequence

features.name: Coverage-vs-parameter curves
